title: DAILY FIGHTER — FOUNDATION WEEK 3 DAY 17
emphasis: Saturday MEDIUM, symptom-adapted: compression, unilateral/squat strength, hip rotation, landing mechanics and lower-leg engine. Current 2026-09-26 front-shoulder tenderness, cross-body pain and sharp pain radiating toward the biceps: upper anchors and throws are withheld; every movement must be pain-free.

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min easy walk. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/C×1/D×1 (19:35), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Zone-2 Treadmill
ignition.cue: RPE 4–5; relaxed shoulders and smooth breathing

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: COMPRESSION — SUPPORT WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 4–6, ≥4 RIR. Compression: NONE VERIFIED; establish bent-knee reps/form. Support withheld. Gate: two user-confirmed clean 3×6–8 exposures before straighter knees.

exercises.name: Seated Pike Compression Leg Lift
exercises.cue: Sit tall; no leaning or bouncing

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: ADAPTED UNILATERAL CONTROL
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 6, 4 RIR. Upper pull/press withheld and not credited. NONE VERIFIED; establish pain-free split-squat load/ROM, then repeat before adding load.

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; quiet knee, level pelvis

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: SQUAT + HIP ROTATION CONTROL
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; squat RPE 7/3 RIR, airplane RPE 5. NONE VERIFIED; establish load/ROM and control. Cable rotation withheld; no rotation benchmark credit.

exercises.name: Heels-Elevated Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Knees track; own depth; record load

exercises.name: Supported Hip Airplane
exercises.cue: LEFT → SWITCH → RIGHT; rotate from hip

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: LANDING MECHANICS — THROW WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6, ≥5 RIR. Rotational throw withheld and not credited. Stop when speed, balance or landing quality declines.

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: LOWER-BODY ENGINE + SHIN ARMOR
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20; 6:30 total; RPE 5–6. Repeatable cadence without posture loss; no loaded-strength progression.

martialSupplement.name: Guard-Retention Leg Pummeling
martialSupplement.home: Dopa band + mat: controlled leg pummeling
martialSupplement.cue: Separate; shoulders relaxed; move from hips; never auto-log
